title: API & Endpoint Inventory Discovery
tags: api openapi swagger graphql rest express node json endpoints discovery
summary: Enumerate undocumented API routes, versioned endpoints (/api/v1, /rest), OpenAPI/Swagger specs, and GraphQL introspection endpoints.
checklist: Probe /openapi.json, /swagger.json, /v3/api-docs, /api-docs, /graphql, and /robots.txt.
Crawl JS bundles with katana (-jc) to extract frontend-referenced REST/GraphQL routes.
Run rate-limited ffuf using the API wordlist against base API paths.

title: Security Headers, TLS, & CORS Misconfiguration Audit
tags: headers cors csp hsts cookies misconfiguration nginx apache express
summary: Inspect HTTP response headers, cookie security attributes (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite), and cross-origin resource sharing (Access-Control-Allow-Origin).
checklist: Verify presence of HSTS, Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options, and X-Content-Type-Options.
Send benign synthetic Origin header to detect arbitrary Origin reflection paired with Allow-Credentials: true.
Run safe nuclei templates tagged misconfig,exposure,headers.

title: SQL Injection Detection & Bounded Verification
tags: sqli sql injection database query search id param sqlite mysql postgres
summary: Identify query/JSON parameters backed by database queries (search, filter, id, login) and verify safely with approval-gated bounded sqlmap.
checklist: Discover hidden GET/POST/JSON parameters on dynamic endpoints with arjun.
Propose Tier-3 approval-gated sqlmap (--level=1 --risk=1) only on specific parameterized targets.

title: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Surface & Verification
tags: xss reflected dom stored html script search q query input angular react
summary: Test reflected and query-driven parameters for unsafe HTML/JS rendering using approval-gated dalfox.
checklist: Collect endpoints with query parameters from katana and arjun.
Verify reflected input handling using Tier-3 approval-gated dalfox.

title: Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA / IDOR) & Auth Checks
tags: idor bola authorization jwt token auth bearer user account order profile api
summary: Inspect API endpoints referencing object IDs (/users/{id}, /orders/{id}, /basket) and verify authorization enforcement via approval-gated HTTP replay.
checklist: Identify REST paths containing numeric IDs, UUIDs, or user-scoped resources.
Verify unauthenticated vs authenticated access boundaries using Tier-3 http_probe replay_request.

title: Framework Fingerprinting & Safe Template Exposure Scan
tags: fingerprint tech express php django rails wordpress spring actuator exposed
summary: Correlate WhatWeb/HTTP headers with targeted non-intrusive Nuclei templates (exposures, panels, CVEs).
checklist: Fingerprint backend server, frontend framework, and WAF presence.
Run Tier-2 safe nuclei scan excluding dos, intrusive, and fuzz tags.

title: JSON Web Token (JWT) Security & Session Analysis
tags: jwt bearer token authorization oauth session cookie alg none exp
summary: Inspect JWT headers and claims for alg=none acceptance, missing expiration (exp), sensitive payload fields, and signature verification bypasses.
checklist: Decode observed JWT headers/claims passively without leaking secrets.
Flag alg=none, missing exp claims, or plaintext credentials inside JWT payloads.

title: GraphQL Introspection & Query Depth Assessment
tags: graphql introspection schema mutation query playground apollo
summary: Check GraphQL endpoints for unauthenticated schema introspection, exposed GraphiQL/Playground consoles, and missing authorization on mutations.
checklist: Send non-mutating __schema introspection check to /graphql.
Review exposed query/mutation surface for privileged or unauthenticated operations.

title: Transport Layer Security (TLS) & Cipher Hardening
tags: https tls ssl certificate cipher hsts sslv3 tlsv1
summary: Audit HTTPS ports for deprecated TLS 1.0/1.1 protocols, weak ciphers (RC4/3DES), and expired or self-signed certificates.
checklist: Run sslscan on HTTPS hosts to verify TLS 1.2/1.3 only and strong AEAD ciphers.
Verify certificate validity and HSTS enforcement.

title: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Parameter Surface
tags: ssrf url uri webhook callback redirect proxy fetch import image
summary: Identify parameters accepting URLs or remote resource references (url, callback, webhook, dest, next) and verify outbound filtering.
checklist: Identify URL/webhook parameters via katana and arjun.
Propose approval-gated Tier-3 verification for unvalidated outbound fetches.

title: Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI) Discovery
tags: ssti template jinja twig pug handlebars ejs freemarker render preview
summary: Detect endpoints reflecting dynamic user-controlled text into server-side template engines.
checklist: Correlate detected frameworks (Jinja2, Twig, Pug, EJS) with user-controlled rendering endpoints.
Escalate suspected reflection points for operator-approved verification.

title: Host Port & Service Surface Fingerprinting
tags: nmap port service ssh ftp redis mongo admin management console
summary: Discover unexpected exposed TCP services, admin panels, or non-standard HTTP ports on allowlisted hosts.
checklist: Run bounded top-100 TCP service discovery with nmap on allowlisted hostnames/IPs.
Audit newly uncovered HTTP/API ports within engagement scope.
